_note: Copy to probe.json and replace every value marked MEASURE with the as-built probe. Units in the keys. tau_int_s is written by 'python fit.py calibrate RUN.csv'.

disc.material: 99.6 % alumina, polished thin-film grade (example; Si3N4 0.32 mm is the C1-exact option)
disc._mass_note: MEASURE on a 0.1 mg balance; example = rho 3870 kg/m3 x pi 4^2 x 0.254 mm3

bond._note: post rim bonded to the disc (10 % of the disc) + 0.10 mm bondline (0.72 mJ/K), as cartridge_budget.py

element.part: IST P0K1.202 family Pt100, class F0.15 or better

_tau_int_note: placeholder until the paste calibration is run
_sys_note: relative (absolute for tau_int_s) probe-constant uncertainties used for the verdict band; C_el drops to ~0.10 if 5 spare elements are weighed together (DECISIONS D6)
